name: Yagisawa Moeka
source:
A 2nd year student in "The Nameless Honeybees" class.

Moeka is the first female student that Neri spoke to when she transferred to the academy. She's also a 2nd year in "The Nameless Honeybees" class like Neri, and acts as her helper of sorts. Moeka has a cheerful and positive personality. Good at taking care of others, she helps and supports Neri in various ways, such as helping Neri learn the academy's rules when she was overwhelmed by the sudden changes in her environment, taking her shopping and accompanying her to the café.

Moeka greatly desires to improve her social standing, and is currently aiming to ascend to the "Roses in Full Bloom" rank. She is completely devoted in self-improvement.

[Translation of her official website character profile.]
